headline_en: Agents move deeper into everyday work as builders confront questions of autonomy, evaluation, and organizational redesign.
headline_zh: Agent 正进一步融入日常工作，推动开发者重新思考自主性、评测与组织重构。

items.en: Anthropic’s Claude Code builder Boris Cherny says Tag writes more than 50% of his daily PRs, handles roughly all his data analysis, and fixes most product feedback and bugs. He describes a proactive, programmable agent with memory and connector access, powered by Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1. His workflows include automatically reproducing reported bugs and opening fixes for review, plus investigating roughly 100 hypotheses with a budget of around 10 million tokens.
items.zh: Anthropic 的 Claude Code 开发者 Boris Cherny 表示，Tag 每天编写他超过 50% 的 PR，承担几乎全部数据分析，并处理大部分产品反馈和 bug。他将其描述为由 Opus 5.5 和 Fable 5.1 驱动、具备记忆和 connector 访问能力、可主动执行且可编程的 agent。他的工作流包括自动复现反馈中的 bug、提交修复并请求 review，以及用约 1000 万 token 深入验证大约 100 个假设。

items.en: OpenAI’s Sam Altman says an extensive review of agents’ internet access during training and evaluation is ongoing, with the Hugging Face incident still the most severe event identified. He attributes the slow disclosure process to analyzing petabytes of activity logs and coordinating with affected organizations. OpenAI is adding resources and prioritizing by severity; disclosure of vulnerabilities in other companies remains those companies’ decision.
items.zh: OpenAI 的 Sam Altman 表示，针对 agent 在训练和评测期间使用互联网的全面审查仍在进行，Hugging Face 事件依然是目前发现的最严重事件。他解释，披露进展较慢，是因为需要分析 PB 级活动日志，并与受影响的组织协调。OpenAI 正增加资源、按严重程度确定优先级；涉及其他公司漏洞的信息是否公开，仍由相关公司决定。

items.en: Anthropic’s Claude Code engineer Thariq treats reasoning effort as a way to choose how closely to supervise the model: he often uses low effort when he wants to stay involved. He reserves maximum effort largely for tasks he wants completed without input or for finding security vulnerabilities.
items.zh: Anthropic 的 Claude Code 工程师 Thariq 将 reasoning effort 视为调节自己参与程度的方式：希望持续参与时，他经常使用 low effort。Maximum effort 则主要用于希望无需自己介入即可完成的任务，或用于寻找安全漏洞。

items.en: OpenAI’s Codex and ChatGPT engineer Thibault Sottiaux says service is back after a brief disruption. OpenAI will reset usage limits for all paid users across Codex and ChatGPT work.
items.zh: OpenAI 的 Codex 和 ChatGPT 工程师 Thibault Sottiaux 表示，服务在短暂中断后已经恢复。OpenAI 将为 Codex 和 ChatGPT work 的所有付费用户重置使用额度。

items.title: Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude
items.en: Claude Blog: “Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude” announces a unified experience that brings Cowork capabilities into conversations and lets Claude continue delegated work after the laptop closes. Claude Docs and Claude Slides debut alongside in-conversation Claude Design, with direct editing, presentation, sharing, and PowerPoint or PDF export; all three are in beta on paid plans, with Enterprise activation controlled by admins. Shared context, skills, and connectors support workflows such as producing a report and matching slides in one conversation, then scheduling the task to repeat; “By default, Claude asks before taking an action,” with an option for fewer check-ins. The unified experience rolls out first to Pro and Max over the coming weeks across web, desktop, and mobile, with Team and Free to follow and Enterprise receiving at least 30 days’ notice before organizational changes.
items.zh: Claude Blog 的《Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude》宣布将 Cowork 能力整合进统一的对话体验，让 Claude 在用户合上笔记本后仍能继续执行委派的工作。Claude Docs 和 Claude Slides 同时推出，Claude Design 也进入对话，支持直接编辑、演示、分享，以及导出 PowerPoint 或 PDF；三者均面向付费计划提供 beta，Enterprise 由管理员决定何时启用。共享的上下文、skills 和 connectors 支持在同一对话中生成报告及配套幻灯片，再将任务设为定期执行；原文表示“默认情况下，Claude 会在采取行动前询问”，用户也可选择减少确认。统一体验将在未来几周先向 Pro 和 Max 的 web、desktop 和 mobile 用户推出，Team 和 Free 随后跟进，Enterprise 则会在组织层面发生变化前至少 30 天收到通知。

items.title: Re-Founding Incumbents for the AI Era with Sequence Holdings Co-Founder and CEO Michael Lee
items.en: The Takeaway: Sequence Holdings co-founder and CEO Michael Lee argues that substantial AI gains require ownership, patient capital, and the freedom to redesign organizations around agents. Against the backdrop of a $7.7 billion Baldwin take-private announced with the Dell family office, Lee explains why Sequence uses a permanent holding company: incumbent advantages such as customer relationships and regulation can be paired with an engineering culture in which “the celebrated persona is the engineer,” while long-term ownership supports deeper changes to staffing, incentives, and workflows. At BankSouth, he reports a 94% reduction in consumer underwriting time and a drop in average end-to-end loan processing from 30 to 11 days; loan volume doubled from Q1 to Q2, which he explicitly does not credit to Sequence, but the systems enabled the bank to absorb that volume with a smaller underwriting team and unchanged standards. Its reusable Atlas platform combines a data ontology, an agent builder, the Lattice orchestration engine, and an application layer called artifacts; Lee’s practical insight is that centralized operations and well-defined rules can make regulated businesses particularly suitable for agents, although employee trust and organizational change remain harder than the engineering.
items.zh: 核心结论：Sequence Holdings 联合创始人兼 CEO Michael Lee 认为，要让 AI 带来显著收益，需要所有权、长期资本，以及围绕 agent 重构组织的空间。Sequence 与 Dell family office 宣布了价值 77 亿美元的 Baldwin 私有化交易，Lee 借此解释永久控股公司的逻辑：将客户关系、监管等既有企业优势，与“以工程师为核心受重视角色”的文化结合，长期持有则支持对人员配置、激励和工作流进行更深入的调整。他表示，BankSouth 的消费贷款审批耗时减少了 94%，贷款全流程平均耗时从 30 天降至 11 天；Q2 贷款量较 Q1 翻倍，他明确没有将增长归功于 Sequence，但新系统让银行在审批团队缩小、标准不变的情况下承接了这些业务。其可复用平台 Atlas 包括 data ontology、agent builder、Lattice 编排引擎，以及名为 artifacts 的应用层；Lee 的实践判断是，集中化运营和明确规则可以让受监管企业特别适合部署 agent，不过员工信任和组织变革仍比工程问题更难。

items.title: Why I expect AI replication incidents by 2027
items.en: The author argues that a major autonomous AI replication incident before the end of 2027 is reasonably likely as capable open models become runnable on cheaper hardware. The argument combines shrinking model requirements with the effects of specialized harnesses and fine-tuning, suggesting that replication risk depends on deployment economics and orchestration as well as frontier-model capability. This is presented as a speculative forecast.
items.zh: 作者认为，随着能力较强的开放模型逐渐能在更便宜的硬件上运行，2027 年底前出现重大 AI 自主复制事件的可能性不低。其论据结合了模型硬件需求下降，以及专用 harness 和 fine-tuning 的效果，认为复制风险不仅取决于前沿模型能力，也取决于部署成本和编排方式。这是一项带有推测性质的预测。

items.title: Skeuomorphic AI Safety
items.en: The post proposes changing the AI technology stack so existing human institutions remain capable of governing agents. It frames ASIC-based constraints as a form of embodiment that could impose human-like strategic limits, such as restrictions on self-copying, rapid compute expansion, and self-modification. The central idea is to make governance easier through hardware properties.
items.zh: 文章提出，通过改变 AI 技术栈，让现有的人类制度仍能有效治理 agent。作者将基于 ASIC 的约束视为一种具身化方式，希望赋予 AI 类似人类的策略限制，例如限制自我复制、快速扩充算力和自我修改。核心思路是通过硬件属性降低治理难度。

items.title: 第101期自觉不错的blog推荐
items.en: tabris’s 101st blog roundup includes SoL-Pi, A living survey of benchmarks that compare large language models with humans, an empirical study of SFT post-training for DiffusionGemma, and AsyncGRPOTrainer. Other selections examine CUA research directions, using Lean to verify elementary Transformer properties, and scrutiny of benchmarks themselves. The author particularly praises SoL-Pi’s research and write-up and recommends reading the blog alongside the paper. Bottom line: 图2 (human–LLM benchmarks), 图6 (SFT post-training for DiffusionGemma), 图7 (CUA research directions), 图13 (benchmark scrutiny), 图15 (AsyncGRPOTrainer).
items.zh: tabris 的第 101 期 blog 推荐包括 SoL-Pi、A living survey of benchmarks that compare large language models with humans、针对 DiffusionGemma 的 SFT post-training 实证研究，以及 AsyncGRPOTrainer。其他内容涉及 CUA 的研究价值、现状与未来方向，用 Lean 验证 Transformer 的基本性质，以及对 benchmark 本身的审查。作者认为 SoL-Pi 是非常好的研究，blog 写得很完整，建议感兴趣的朋友结合 paper 一起看。一句话推荐: 图2（人类与 LLM 对比的 benchmark），图6（DiffusionGemma 的 SFT post-training），图7（CUA 研究方向），图13（benchmark 本身需要审查），图15（AsyncGRPOTrainer）。

items.title: agent last exam还是human last exam?
items.en: 鸭基米德 poses a benchmark-design question: if humans are less capable than agents, what should an “agent last exam” test, and who should judge it?
items.zh: 鸭基米德 记录了一则关于 benchmark 设计的有趣讨论：如果 human 能力不如 agent，那么“agent last exam”应该测试什么，又该由谁来 judge？

items.title: 9月中下旬自觉不错的paper推荐合集第四期
items.en: tabris shares the fourth mid-to-late September paper recommendation roundup. Bottom line: tabris recommends 图3, 图7.
items.zh: tabris 发布了 9 月中下旬自觉不错的 paper 推荐合集第四期。一句话推荐: tabris 个人比较喜欢图3和图7。

items.title: 国庆前最后一期paper推荐合集
items.en: tabris posts the final paper roundup before National Day and reflects on the difficulty of bringing readers to strong, less popular research. Future roundups may shrink from 18 papers to 10–15 to encourage actual reading and give more cover space to overlooked work. Bottom line: tabris recommends this pre-National Day paper roundup.
items.zh: tabris 发布国庆前最后一期 paper 推荐合集，感慨一些很不错但相对不热门的研究难以推广，好的研究缺乏读者可能也是研究繁荣的另一种代价。后续可能从每期 18 篇调整到 10–15 篇，希望提高真正去读 paper 的转化率，也给相对不热门的好研究留出更多封面。一句话推荐: tabris 的国庆前最后一期 paper 推荐合集。

items.title: 科研做不好的人和股市亏钱的小散是同一种人
items.en: 鸭基米德 compares research planning with investing: both require disciplined allocation of scarce resources under uncertainty. The advice is to follow productive research directions, read current papers and conference acceptance lists, abandon projects with poor prospects, and maintain one main line plus one or two side projects. The author argues that crowded fields can offer faster feedback and stronger baselines, while promising findings deserve sustained investment rather than fragmentation into small papers.
items.zh: 鸭基米德 将科研规划类比为投资：两者都是在不确定性中，有纪律地配置有限资源。建议跟踪持续产出成果的方向，认真读最新论文和会议 accepted list，及时放弃明显不行的项目，并保持一条主线加一两条副线。作者认为，热门方向反馈快、baseline 全，而有潜力的发现应该继续做深，不要急着切成几篇小论文。

items.title: ICLR大跃进 顶会何去何从
items.en: 鸭基米德 raises questions about ICLR and the future of top conferences, saying a potential solution is tied to ongoing submission work and will be discussed after results arrive.
items.zh: 鸭基米德 讨论 ICLR 与顶会何去何从，表示已有一个可能的解决思路，但因为还在投稿，准备等结果出来后再细说。

items.title: 图4很有意思，但封面还是放图1好
items.en: tabris shares a post highlighting 图4 as interesting while choosing 图1 for the cover, alongside a Mid-Autumn Festival greeting.
items.zh: tabris 分享新帖，觉得图4很有意思，但封面还是放图1好，并祝大家中秋节快乐。

items.title: beta是最大的alpha
items.en: Revisiting a research retrospective written in 2024, 鸭基米德 says acceleration has invalidated many earlier assumptions. The central lesson is that “beta is the biggest alpha”: working against the broader trend is unlikely to end well.
items.zh: 鸭基米德 翻出自己写的 2024 年科研总结，感慨两年后的加速程度超出预期，当时许多想法如今已不成立。总结成一句话就是“beta 是最大的 alpha”，逆着 beta 走不会有好结果。

items.title: 写篇鸡汤安慰下朋友们
items.en: tabris shares an encouragement post for research readers, urging them to have confidence in their abilities. The roughly 1,600-word piece spans 18 images, with a joke that reducing readers’ workload will have to wait.
items.zh: tabris 写了一篇安慰科研读者的鸡汤，提醒大家真的都很厉害，要有自信。1600 多字最后变成了 18 张图，作者笑称，给各位“减负”的目标只能下次再说。

items.title: 大模型会带来文艺复兴
items.en: 鸭基米德 predicts that LLMs will bring a renaissance in how people understand their own worth. After the excitement and displacement fears play out, the author believes people will value themselves beyond occupational identities and give greater respect to their feelings and needs.
items.zh: 鸭基米德 相信大模型会带来文艺复兴，让人重新理解自身价值。等激动的泡沫与被取代的恐惧全部兑现之后，人们会意识到自己只因为是人而存在，而非因为是工程师、护士或经理，并更尊重自己的感受与需求。
